points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 卡拉瓦乔出生于意大利米兰的一个艺术世家。他的早期生活并不为人所知，但据推测，他在这里接受了基本的艺术训练。
points.descriptionEn: Caravaggio was born into an artistic family in Milan, Italy. Little is known about his early life, but it is believed that he received basic art training here.

points.title: 罗马时期
points.description: 卡拉瓦乔在1592年抵达罗马，并迅速成为该城市艺术界的一颗新星。他在这里创作了许多重要的作品，如《圣马太的召唤》和《圣马太的灵感》。他的风格独特，对后来的巴洛克艺术产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Caravaggio arrived in Rome in 1592 and quickly became a star of the city's art scene. He created many important works here, such as 'The Calling of St. Matthew' and 'The Inspiration of St. Matthew'. His unique style had a profound impact on later Baroque art.

points.title: 那不勒斯时期
points.description: 卡拉瓦乔在1595年前往那不勒斯，并在这里度过了五年时间。他在那不勒斯期间创作了《基督下十字架》等作品，进一步发展了他的现实主义风格。
points.descriptionEn: Caravaggio traveled to Naples in 1595 and spent five years there. During this time, he created works such as 'The Descent from the Cross', further developing his realistic style.

points.title: 第二次罗马时期
points.description: 卡拉瓦乔在1600年返回罗马，并在这里度过了他生命的最后六年。他在这里创作了许多重要的作品，包括《圣约翰的洗礼》和《圣马太的殉难》。他的风格继续影响着后来的艺术家。
points.descriptionEn: Caravaggio returned to Rome in 1600 and spent the last six years of his life there. He created many important works here, including 'The Baptism of St. John' and 'The Martyrdom of St. Matthew'. His style continued to influence later artists.

points.title: 马耳他时期
points.description: 卡拉瓦乔在1606年被任命为马耳他骑士团画家，并在那里度过了他生命的最后几个月。他在马耳他创作了《圣约翰的胜利》等作品，但不久后因涉嫌谋杀被驱逐出岛。
points.descriptionEn: Caravaggio was appointed painter to the Order of St. John in Malta in 1606 and spent the last few months of his life there. He created works such as 'The Victory of St. John' in Malta, but was soon expelled from the island for suspected murder.

supporter.zh: 卡拉瓦乔被视为巴洛克艺术的先驱，他的作品以其强烈的情感表达和现实主义风格而闻名。他的贡献在于对后世艺术家的影响，尤其是对巴洛克艺术的发展产生了深远的影响。
supporter.en: Caravaggio is considered a pioneer of Baroque art, known for his strong emotional expression and realistic style. His contribution lies in his influence on later artists, particularly his profound impact on the development of Baroque art.

critic.zh: 卡拉瓦乔的生活充满争议，包括与他人的冲突和涉嫌犯罪的行为。他的现实主义风格有时被认为过于直白，缺乏传统艺术的优雅。
critic.en: Caravaggio's life was marked by controversy, including conflicts with others and suspected criminal behavior. His realistic style is sometimes seen as too straightforward, lacking the elegance of traditional art.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，卡拉瓦乔被视为一个复杂的人物，他的艺术成就与个人生活的混乱并存。他的作品在艺术史上占有重要地位，但他的个人行为也引发了广泛的讨论。
objective.en: In the historical perspective, Caravaggio is seen as a complex figure, with his artistic achievements coexisting with the chaos of his personal life. His works hold an important place in art history, but his personal behavior has also sparked widespread discussion.

self.zh: 我试图通过我的画来讲述故事，而不是仅仅描绘它们。
self.en: I try to tell stories with my paintings, not just depict them.

others.zh: 卡拉瓦乔是绘画史上最伟大的画家之一，他的作品具有革命性的力量。
others.en: Caravaggio is one of the greatest painters in the history of art, whose works have revolutionary power.
